sections.title: An Announcement of Telnet Options
sections.content: RFC 659 announces that the Telnet options defined in RFCs 651 through 658 are part of the official Telnet options. It asks that they be added to the Protocol Notebook. This memo announces the documents; it does not define their detailed behavior.
sections.plainLanguage: This memo tells readers that eight other documents define additional Telnet options. Read those documents for the option rules.

sections.title: What the Announced Options Cover
sections.content: RFC 651 revises the Status option to use the subcommand feature and reduce the number of bits needed for status information. The revision replaces the previous Status option. RFCs 652 through 658 define options for controlling how carriage return, horizontal tab, form feed, vertical tab and line feed format text.
sections.plainLanguage: One document revises the Telnet Status option. The other seven define ways to control how text-formatting characters behave.

sections.title: Finding the Documents
sections.content: The memo lists online file locations for the option documents and RFC 645, a document on network standard data specification syntax. It says that the Network Information Center could not provide printed copies at the time and that authors were responsible for distributing RFCs.
sections.plainLanguage: The memo points readers to online files for the detailed specifications. It also notes that printed copies were not available from the Network Information Center.
